name: speak-lite
description: A miniature language learning portal: browse courses, view lessons, and stream speech to a real-time ASR service.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev:mock -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
